from google.cloud import texttospeech
from speech_client import get_client

def select_voice(language_code):
    client = get_client()
    voices = client.list_voices(language_codes_filter=[language_code])
    return [voice.name for voice in voices]

import os

def save_audio(audio_bytes, file_path):
    with open(file_path, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(audio_bytes)

import requests

def translate_text(text, target_language):
    response = requests.post('https://translation.googleapis.com/language/translate/v2',
        params={'key': os.getenv('GOOGLE_CLOUD_API_KEY')},
        data={'q': text, 'target': target_language})
    return response.json()['data']['translations'][0]['translatedText']

import requests

def check_safety(text):
    response = requests.post('https://content-moderation.googleapis.com/v1/moderate',
        params={'key': os.getenv('GOOGLE_CLOUD_API_KEY')},
        json={'content': text})
    return response.json()['toxicity']

import requests

def embed_text(text):
    response = requests.post('https://ai.googleapis.com/v1/text:embed',
        params={'key': os.getenv('GOOGLE_CLOUD_API_KEY')},
        json={'text': text})
    return response.json()['embedding']
